dataset.name: HIV-associated diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (HTMCP)
dataset.description: Independent HIV-associated diffuse large B-cell lymphoma cohort with open GDC-harmonized bulk RNA-seq STAR-counts and linked overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: CGCI HIV+ Tumor Molecular Characterization Project DLBCL biopsies. This clinically specific cohort remains separate from TCGA-DLBC and from other external DLBCL releases.

metadata.redistribution_note: The open cohort is analyzable in TRACE Explorer, but matrix downloads remain disabled pending a dedicated redistribution review.
metadata.curation_note: Only primary-tumor STAR-counts files are eligible. One project expression profile whose sample type is not reported is excluded before endpoint intersection.

expression.label: log2(TPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: GDC STAR-counts GENCODE v36 gene_id and gene_name fields
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Distinct Ensembl gene identifiers sharing one supplied symbol are excluded rather than merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The GDC STAR-counts files supply non-negative tpm_unstranded values. TRACE Explorer applies log2(TPM + 1) once.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Diagnosis as implemented by the GDC survival endpoint
